# The Pickleball Passport (thepickleballpassport.org)

> The Pickleball Passport designs and operates luxury 5-star multi-city pickleball vacations, structured coaching clinic weeks, and private club destination trips in Thailand across Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Hua Hin, Pattaya, and Phuket, supported by a dedicated on-the-ground team in Bangkok and local Thai destination management company (DMC) partners.

## Core Trips & Coaching Clinics
- [Home](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/): Overview of The Pickleball Passport 5-star Thailand pickleball vacations and clinic programs.
- [All Upcoming Thailand Trips](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/trips): 9-Day / 8-Night all-inclusive multi-city pickleball and cultural trips ($5,500; 16 players across 4 dedicated courts).
- [Full 2027 Departure Calendar](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/trips/calendar): Monthly 2027 Thailand departures alternating Chiang Mai, Hua Hin, Phuket, and Pattaya.
- [Jan 14 to 22, 2027: Bangkok + Chiang Mai Trip](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/trips/bangkok-chiang-mai/january-14-2027): 9 days, 8 nights in Bangkok and Chiang Mai during prime cool season ($5,500).
- [Feb 18 to 26, 2027: Bangkok + Hua Hin Trip](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/trips/bangkok-hua-hin/february-18-2027): 9 days, 8 nights combining Bangkok courts with Hua Hin coastal play ($5,500).
- [Mar 18 to 26, 2027: Bangkok + Phuket Trip](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/trips/bangkok-phuket/march-18-2027): 9 days, 8 nights pairing Bangkok indoor complexes with Andaman island recovery ($5,500).
- [Apr 12 to 20, 2027: Songkran + Wan Lai (Bangkok + Pattaya)](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/trips/bangkok-pattaya/songkran-april-2027): Thai New Year festival departure across Bangkok and Pattaya ($5,500).
- [Bangkok Pickleball Clinic Week (Nov 1 to 5, 2026)](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/clinics): Four sessions of mindset coaching with Coach Travis Rhea (Mind Your Pickle) and live coaching with Jaron and Ryan across Arise Pickleball and Papaya Pickleball Club in Bangkok ($169 Two-Day Pass / $299 Full Clinic Week).
- [Reserve Clinic Week Pass](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/reserve): Direct booking page for Bangkok Clinic Week.
- [Apply for a 9-Day Trip](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/apply): Application and reservation inquiry for 2027 multi-city Thailand cohorts.
- [Partners & Featured Coaches](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/partners): Meet Bharat "BK" Karunakaran, Coach Travis Rhea, Siree & Sang Chanyaputhipong (Arise Pickleball), and Neil Friedenberg (The Dinking Dad).
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/faq): Answers on skill levels, travel logistics, accommodations, and non-playing companions.

## Free Thailand Pickleball Guides & Tools ("Assets Magnets" Cluster)
- [The Thailand Pickleball Playbook 2026 (All 5 Cities & 15 Courts)](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/thailand-pickleball-playbook): Vetted directory of 15 pickleball courts across Bangkok, Hua Hin, Pattaya, Chiang Mai, and Phuket, plus heat survival rules, Reclub/LINE booking tips, and a 9-day itinerary blueprint.
- [Downloadable Playbook PDF (23 Pages)](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/thailand-pickleball-playbook-2026.pdf): Full 23-page PDF version of The Thailand Pickleball Playbook 2026.
- [Thailand Pickleball Trip & Court Cost Calculator (THB & USD)](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/thailand-pickleball-calculator): Interactive calculator modeling court fees, private indoor bookings, Grab/BTS transport, domestic flights, and 4-star vs. 5-star hotels in Thai Baht and USD.
- [Where to Play Pickleball in Bangkok (2026 Local Guide)](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/bangkok-pickleball-courts): Deep-dive guide to Arise Pickleball (Udom Suk), Sterling Sport & Wellness, and Papaya Pickleball, including BTS/Grab transit times and Reclub/LINE booking scripts.
- [How Pickleball Clubs & Coaches Run Destination Trips to Thailand](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/pickleball-club-retreats): B2B operational guide for club owners, directors of racquet sports, and coaches planning 16-player, 4-court private member trips to Thailand.
- [Best Time to Visit Thailand for Pickleball (Month-by-Month Guide)](https://www.thepickleballpassport.org/best-time-to-visit-thailand-for-pickleball): Seasonal weather, humidity windows, Chiang Mai air quality calendar, and city pairings from January through December.
